title: Roasted Red Pepper Shakshuka with Pita
changes_from_base: A small piece of pita is blended with drained tomatoes and half the roasted peppers to give a thick, smooth sauce, with diced peppers, coriander, smoked paprika and cayenne; eight eggs, then feta and olives, with pita wedges to serve.
summary: A fragrant Middle Eastern egg dish in a thick, smooth sauce of roasted peppers and tomatoes, topped with creamy feta and tangy olives.
equipment: 30 cm frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fresh coriander, leaves and tender stems roughly chopped

steps.title: Prepare Pita
steps.text: Cut 4 pita breads into wedges for serving, then cut about one-third of one pita into 1 cm pieces.

steps.title: Blend Sauce
steps.text: Blend the pita pieces, 800 g drained tinned whole peeled tomatoes and half of 450 g jarred roasted red peppers (drained) for 1-2 minutes until smooth; dice the remaining peppers into 5 mm pieces.

steps.title: Soften Garlic
steps.text: Heat 60 ml extra-virgin olive oil in a 30 cm frying pan over medium heat and cook 4 thinly sliced garlic cloves 1-2 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp tomato purée, 2 tsp ground coriander, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground cumin, ½ tsp fine salt and ¼ tsp each of ground black pepper and cayenne, cooking and stirring 1-2 minutes until rust-coloured.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the smooth pepper and tomato purée along with the diced peppers and simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until slightly thick (a spatula leaves a slow-closing trail); off the heat, make 8 shallow hollows (7 around the edge, 1 in the middle).

steps.title: Add Eggs
steps.text: Crack 8 large eggs into small bowls and carefully tip each into a hollow; spoon sauce over the edge of each egg white, bring back to a simmer over medium, cover and cook 4-5 minutes until the yolks film over, then 1-2 minutes more until the whites are softly set and each egg wobbles as one.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, scatter 8 g chopped fresh coriander, 28 g crumbled feta and 35 g sliced Kalamata olives over the top; serve with the pita wedges.

tips: Blend the pita with the sauce to give it a rich body and silky consistency
Use the spatula test to gauge when the sauce has thickened sufficiently
If you are serving pregnant, very young, elderly or immunocompromised eaters, keep cooking 1-2 minutes after the yolks film over until they are firm (71 °C)
storage: Serve straight away. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
